title: Yellowed Crispy Italian Cheese Skewers
description: A light Italian dish featuring cheese slices, this recipe is perfect for a snack or appetizer, with a floral and shaggy texture from the cheese and fresh herbs
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Thread a mozzarella cheese slice, a cherry tomato half, and a sprinkle of chopped fresh basil onto each skewer
Drizzle the skewers with extra virgin olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning
Sprinkle a pinch of lemon zest over the cheese for added flavor
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and slightly browned
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a minute or two
Serve the Yellowed Crispy Italian Cheese Skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh basil if desired
